svg.title: Tech stack as a single-line diagram
svg.desc: A solar module feeds an inverter and a busbar. Current runs down the bus into one feeder per layer and switches on each technology. Languages: C#, JavaScript, SQL, Elixir, Python. Front-end: AngularJS, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap. Back-end: .NET, Node.js, Express, Prisma. Database: SQL Server, PostgreSQL. Tools: Git, Docker.
